title: Binding Energy Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the semiempirical binding energy formula for a nucleus (A, Z).

title: Mean Binding Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the concept of mean binding energy per nucleon and its significance.

title: Energy Contributions
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify and describe the contributions of volume, surface, Coulomb, symmetry, and pairing energies to binding energy.

title: Trends in Binding Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the binding energy per nucleon varies with mass number A and atomic number Z, particularly for Fe and U.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the contributions of the different energy terms or misinterpreting the trends.
